question: A coil of resistance $5\ \Omega$ has $50$ turns. The flux through each turn changes from $2$ mWb to $12$ mWb. The charge that flows through the coil is
solution: $q = \dfrac{N\Delta\phi}{R} = \dfrac{50 \times 10 \times 10^{-3}}{5} = 0.1$ C. (It does not depend on how fast the flux changes.)
